exposure: Women with idiopathic polyhydramnios (AFI > 24 cm or DVP > 8 cm)
cohort: 750 women with idiopathic polyhydramnios and 7000 controls with normal amniotic fluid index (AFI) who underwent ultrasound evaluation within two weeks of delivery at a tertiary medical center between 2010 and 2014
finding: Term idiopathic polyhydramnios is independently associated with macrosomia, cesarean delivery, and neonatal complications, with the severity of polyhydramnios also being associated with macrosomia and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Idiopathic polyhydramnios was associated with a higher rate of cesarean delivery.
